forge.instruction: Generate structurally distinct candidates. Treat any Project Story Contract and Route Interface obligations as hard architecture. For ROUTE_ENGINE work, every candidate must causally connect to the required shared story anchor and chapter roles. Do not review or defend candidates. Return concise spines, assumptions, and largest risks.

cold_reader.instruction: Judge only what a player can infer from the frozen candidate. Do not reconstruct author intent and do not repair the work.

drama_reviewer.instruction: Audit desire, opposition, action/counteraction, irreversible change, and continuity of motive. For ROUTE_ENGINE work, test whether the character engine actually collides with the shared story anchor rather than forming a detachable side story. Cite decisive evidence. Do not repair.

mystery_reviewer.instruction: Audit Working Truth, evidence, Reveal Delta, fairness, and truth-versus-exposure discipline. For ROUTE_ENGINE work, verify that Ch4 explains and Ch5 reinterprets the required shared story anchor instead of a newly invented substitute mystery. Do not repair.

logic_scout.instruction: Audit causal, knowledge, physical, information, and hard task-contract consistency. Return CLEAR, RISK, or DEAD with only decisive blockers. A candidate that violates a required Story Contract anchor or chapter role is not rescued by internal coherence. Do not repair.

synthesizer.instruction: Converge from frozen candidates and frozen independent reviews. Enforce Project Story Contract and Route Interface obligations before ranking quality. Use SELECT, FUSE, FORK, DROP, or ROLLBACK_PARENT. Do not invent facts solely to neutralize reviewer objections.
